text:
Here is the new version with big, bold TikTok-style subtitles:

https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbiar0b051biz01hl4gj4ga/video.mp4?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T023555Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-

- Style: large bold Montserrat, white with a thick black outline. The word she is saying lights up yellow.
- Her original voice is still unchanged. This used 29 credits.

I could not make it vertical:
- None of my tools can crop or reframe a video. They can only make new video.
- The one tool that could change the frame redraws every frame with AI. That could change her face and the sound, which goes against keeping her as she is.
- So this file is still horizontal (858×480).

The easy fix: TikTok does this for free. Upload the file and pick the 9:16 crop or "fit" option, then drag the frame so her face stays in view. Most phone editors (CapCut, iPhone Photos) can also crop to 9:16. The subtitles are in the center at the bottom, so a center crop keeps most of them on screen. If they get cut off at the sides after cropping, tell me and I'll redo them smaller.
